verses.1: For the destruction of the children of Korach, from the word of God.
verses.2: Hear this, all the nations! Listen carefully, all those who dwell in Chaldea.
verses.3: Even human children, and even the children of men, can become rich together.
verses.4: My lips speak wisdom and knowledge; my heart is full of insights.
verses.5: At that time, my ears will open like a lock.
verses.6: Why do I suffer in times of evil? My troubles follow me everywhere.
verses.7: Those who trust in their strength and their many riches will surely rejoice.
verses.8: One who does not heal will not be able to heal anyone; one who does not give to God will not be able to give anything.
verses.9: And Yekar Pidion’s soul was freed, and he stopped to live forever.
verses.10: And he will never see the light again for all eternity.
verses.11: For when the wise men see that they have died together, like a fool and an old man, they will be left behind, and others will take their place.
verses.12: They were brought into eternity from their dwellings, to live forever. Their names were remembered on the earth.
verses.13: And anyone who visits the Valley of the Dead will be treated like animals.
verses.14: That is their way of living; they follow that path. And those who follow them also desire to live in accordance with that path.
verses.15: Like a dog that barks when it sees death, they rushed upon them in the morning. They were like wolves that attacked their prey from afar.
verses.16: But God will save my soul from the hands of Sheol, for He will take me away.
verses.17: Do not be afraid, for no one will be able to increase his honor or fame.
verses.18: For it is not through his death that all will be taken away; no glory will descend after him.
verses.19: For his soul in life will bless and praise you, for it is good for you.
verses.20: He will come back to his ancestors, but he will never see the light again.
verses.21: A man who visits but doesn’t understand will be treated like animals.
